per_step_joint_so3_error.note:
per_step_joint_so3_error provides vector-form SO(3) errors epsilon_{t,j} for offline analysis.
- body: epsilon = so3_log_map(R_pred^T @ R_gt) converted to degrees, axis in joint-local (pred) frame.
- world: epsilon = so3_log_map(R_gt @ R_pred^T) converted to degrees, axis in world frame.
Recommended mask (for Stage7-style analysis): cycle>=1 + drop wrap_boundary_step + exclude root.
